name: coverage_poses
title: Coverage poses
description: The deployment's runs as poses, decimated as coverage_samples is; at most 150,000 rows.

fields.name: t
fields.description: seconds from the run's start (the target's start)

fields.name: situation
fields.description: one way of playing the run, one series on screen: real, real B, twin v7, model 2, target

fields.name: source
fields.description: the situation's family: real, sim (every model, twin, replay or prediction) or target; it picks the hue

fields.name: body
fields.description: the rigid body the row tracks: tool0, lever_tip

fields.name: frame
fields.description: the frame the coordinates are written in: base, belt (one body, one frame; never guessed)

fields.name: quat_w
fields.description: orientation, unitless, w x y z (needed for frames and Z-arcs)

fields.name: w
fields.description: the row's weight: 1 on the uniform time grid (display_hz), 0 on a run's kept argmin / argmax rows; a histogram sums w, min / max over rows stay exact
